item.title: Super Sub: World Cup (Devlog)
item.description:
Welcome to my devlog (or “developer’s diary”) for the game Super Sub: World Cup.

It’s a unique mix of an incremental/management game and a more action/arcade-y game. Almost every part of the game was something I never did before, or not in this specific way, which made this project full of interesting problems and lessons learned ;)

item.title: Super Sub: Keeper Cup (Devlog)
item.description: If you’re reading this devlog, then you probably know that I’ve been making several “Super Sub” games lately. It started with the idea to create a mixture of an incremental game and a sports game. My first attempt felt mediocre (“meh”), which turned into lots of prototypes to “find the fun”, which meant I suddenly had many different folders on my computer named “Super Sub: SOMETHING”.

item.title: Company of the Tackling Tourists
item.description:
Welcome to another devlog!

This time, we’ll talk about the process behind Company of the Tackling Tourists, the game with the longest name (among all my projects) to date.
